Introduction. Ghosts are aggressive creatures found in Black Forests within Burial Chambers, and as part of "You feel a chill down your spine..." raid event.

Attack. Swings their hand sideways in a 1.7-meter 90-degree horizontal arc to scratch the player (25 Slash damage). This attack can be used every 2 seconds when within 1.2 meters of a player.

Notes. • Like Leviathans, they do not respawn, making them a finite creature when raids are disabled.
